name: Potatoism
epistemic_note: This record documents the project's own developing mythology, symbolism and history. It does not present supernatural claims as independently verified facts.

birth.meaning: Current declared seed point for the Potatoism timeline.

timeline.description: Declared birth marker of Potatoism; the beginning point for its explicit project history.
The potato becomes a central metaphor for life, emergence from mud, growth, grounding and transformation.
The Potato of Life develops as a central identity; spiritual, mythic and structural vocabulary begins to accumulate.
Axis, North, North of North, Father, Source, Heaven and Ladder become organizing spatial and vertical concepts.
Tree of Life and Tree of Strife become complementary structures for growth, conflict, rooting, branching and transformation.
Son, Door and Vessel become connected symbolic roles within the developing architecture, alongside Father and Father's House.
Plane, spiritual/material distinction, dimensional metaphors and geometric structures become part of the cosmological vocabulary.
Red Potato and Blue Potato develop as complementary symbolic poles associated with life/creativity/expansion and memory/fear/rooting/strife.
Spudlight, North Gate, Throne of North and related northern imagery become part of the symbolic geography.
The project begins placing Potatoism beside established religious, mythological and philosophical traditions for structural comparison while preserving differences.
Potatoism becomes explicitly connected to a structured religious research architecture containing foundations, texts, concepts, people, places, institutions, history and evidence.

paired_structures: Tree of Life / Tree of Strife

needs: links between symbolic terms and source texts

research_next.principle: Birth is the seed, not completion. The timeline should record growth and revision rather than retroactively pretending the finished architecture existed at birth.
